what: one pick on a stadium boss top rim chamfers the whole tangent loop, also when the part is more than 200 mm across
method: plate 145x145x10 + stadium boss (straights 40, end arcs R5) 10 tall = 145^2*10 + 10*(40*10 + pi*25). One pick takes the whole tangent chain: 2 straight edges of c^2/2*40 = 20 each, plus the two end half-arcs, one full revolution of the triangle (c^2/2) about the boss axis at its centroid radius R - c/3 (Pappus): c^2/2*2*pi*(R - c/3) = 14.66, with c=1, R=5. Removed 54.66 in all. The tolerance is tightened to 5e-6 because the whole-rim result differs from the one-edge result (21.5) by 0.015% of the part volume. Faces: plate 6 (the top with the boss footprint cut out stays one face) + boss walls 4 + boss top 1 + 4 chamfer faces = 15.
